jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (Private Markets)
jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $200M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
What you'll do
You'll be a dedicated point of contact for our private markets clients, helping them get lasting value from Legora across their teams, their portfolio and the advisers they work with. You'll partner closely with our regional teams to give these clients a consistent, high-touch experience wherever they operate.
Grow and deepen client relationships
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at private equity and other private markets firms.
Identify new ways Legora can support clients across their organisations and wider networks, working with the account owners in each region.
Help turn successful engagements into repeatable approaches the wider team can use.
Act as a dedicated post-sale contact for private markets clients, working alongside our regional engagement teams.
Coordinate across regions, to deliver an exceptional client experience.
Spot risks early and work with internal teams to resolve issues before they escalate.
Bring the client's voice into Legora
Share client feedback and requirements with Product to help shape what we build for private markets.
Connect clients with relevant peers, resources and expertise across Legora.
Collaborate within Legora to best support your customers
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Legal Engineering and Deal Desk to deliver a seamless experience from contract to renewal.
Keep account plans, notes and forecasts up to date so the wider team has a clear picture of each relationship.
Share what's working with colleagues and help build best practice for serving private markets clients.
What you'll bring
Experience in account management, customer success or partnerships, ideally in B2B SaaS
Familiarity with private equity, private markets or legal services
Structured thinking and a knack for bringing order to complex relationships
Credibility with senior stakeholders at investment firms and law firms
Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer
At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
About us
At Legora, we're on a mission to transform the way lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal professionals work more efficiently, collaborate more effectively, and focus on the work that matters most. We build closely with our clients, move at a market-leading pace, and are scaling rapidly across teams and geographies.
Legal Data is the foundation of what Legora knows. The team decides which legal sources our users can rely on (legislation, case law, and commentary from leading publishers) and makes them available across a growing number of markets, through our own content build and partnerships with publishers and institutions worldwide.
The role 
We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help Legal Data decide where to invest globally—and build the systems and cross-functional processes that turn those decisions into delivery. You'll connect client demand, content usage and partnership opportunities for digital collection to clear priorities, and create the operating model that helps the team scale.
You'll bring structure to a fast-moving area without adding unnecessary process. Much of what you build doesn't exist yet, so you should be comfortable starting from an ambiguous problem, forming a practical approach, and improving it as you go.
This is an individual-contributor role with broad ownership and global reach. You'll be part of the Engineering & Product Operations team, with a dotted line to the Head of Legal Data, and work closely with Legal Data, Product, Engineering, Growth and Legal across Legora. A legal background is not required.
The role’s key responsibilities are:
Support content prioritisation for our digital collection.
 Build evidence-based recommendations on which jurisdictions, legal sources and data types to prioritise sources, balancing client needs, commercial impact, the competitive and publisher landscape, and delivery feasibility.
Turn client demand into strategic insight.
 Establish a consistent intake process for source and data requests, and combine client conversations, Voice of the Customer insights, inbound partnership opportunities and usage data into actionable recommendations.
Build the fact base for investment decisions.
 Develop business cases for build (e.g., APIs, bulk feeds, scraping of public sources), buy and partner choices.
Build and run Legal Data's operating model.
 Own planning, reporting, systems and tooling; create onboarding processes and playbooks; and coordinate cross-functional projects across Legal Data, Product, Engineering, Growth and Legal to run digital collection operations.

jobs.title: People Product Lead
jobs.description_text:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
Why this role exists
Multiverse builds AI products for the future of work, and we want our own People team to run on the same principles we sell to customers. This role is about building an AI-native People function from the ground up, with someone who thinks in systems: workflows, guardrails, tasks and constraints, rather than one-off fixes. We care more about how you learn and build than how many years you've clocked up. If you've built something you can show us, whether that's a tool, a process, or a system that scaled, bring it. That's a bigger part of the interview than a standard work history.
What you'll actually do
A People Product Lead bridges People strategy with hands-on technical product management. You will build scalable foundations for internal operations such as core HR systems, automation, access, and data flows supporting ~1000 employees across the lifecycle
Define the long-term vision, strategy, and quarterly roadmap for internal People Ops technology and platforms including success measures for the domain.
Build scalable foundations across People systems that support the employee lifecycle, from core People platforms to integrations, data flows, identity and automation.
Make high-quality trade-offs across build, buy and integrate decisions, balancing user experience, scalability, reliability, security and compliance.
Lead through influence by aligning senior stakeholders across People, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Legal, Analytics and Operations.
Improve productivity and reduce friction for Multiverse employees by simplifying processes and creating intuitive, reliable technology experiences.
Drive measurable impact by defining KPIs, learning from delivery and continuously improving how the domain operates.
You will be successful if…
You have 5+ years working in HR, in technology, analytics, or operations
You think in systems: workflows, guardrails, constraints, and how the parts fit together
You have a strong track record of learning fast and applying it
You've built something real you can walk us through: a tool, a process, or a system you scaled
This role won’t work for you if…
You're uncomfortable working with technology and automation
You prefer high-touch, service-led processes over product-led ways of working
Benefits
Time off
 - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year
Health & Wellness
- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support
Hybrid work offering
 - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month
Work-from-anywhere scheme 
- you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year
